func run(groups: [[Int]]) async throws {
 for batch in groups {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  await withDiscardingTaskGroup { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { await save(item) } }
  }
 }
 for batch in groups {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingDiscardingTaskGroup { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { try await save(item) } }
  }
 }
}
